title: previewHistoryPrune
responsibility: Builds and renders a report-only verification-cache retention inventory, marking every matching record as protected because durable deletion proof is unavailable.

inputs.name: previewHistoryPrune.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to resolve the verification cache and query the current Git HEAD.

inputs.name: previewHistoryPrune.keepLast
inputs.description: Maximum number of newest valid records retained regardless of age; must be a safe integer from 0 through 100000.

inputs.name: previewHistoryPrune.olderThanDays
inputs.description: Age threshold for inventory matches; must be a safe integer from 1 through 36500 days.

inputs.name: previewHistoryPrune.now
inputs.description: Clock value used to calculate the cutoff; defaults to the current time.

inputs.name: renderPrune.result
inputs.description: Report-only inventory returned by previewHistoryPrune, including protected entries and scan problems.

outputs.name: previewHistoryPrune
outputs.description: Retention inventory with matching records marked protected; no cache files are modified and apply is unsupported.

outputs.name: renderPrune
outputs.description: Human-readable summary of matching protected records and scan problems.

errors.name: Invalid retention bounds or cache inventory failure
errors.description: Invalid keep-last or age bounds throw; underlying Git or filesystem operations may also reject.
